status: FROZEN before either oversampling run was trained and before any forecast of them existed. The SHA-256 of this file is recorded in the commit that froze it. Amendments only before any result is seen.
title: Oversampling heavy-rain states: an alternative to the tail term, and a complement to it
origin: The tail term reweights the loss on the few heavy-rain states a batch holds, and Pavo + spectral's gain over controlfft2000 is sure at 10 and 20 mm but not shown at 50 mm (-2.0 % [-6.8, +2.8], 603 events). Drawing heavy states more often gives the model more of them to learn from, with or without the tail term.
weights: ~/bris-runs/oversample/weights.json, sha256 df1f3d1eddac3b762a757764edf33e03f7fc746b49320d538fe2082a54c90fb8, from scripts/oversample_weights.py over ~/bris-runs/extremes/meps-year3.json and meps-year2.json, training period 2023-10-01..2025-03-31, measure area_ge_20, top 0.10, factor 4: 219 of 2191 states weighted, expected share of draws 0.308. Built before this plan was frozen, from the training data only.
sampling: xbris.patches weighted training draws: the training dataset draws with replacement by weight from its own seeded generator; validation and test are not reweighted; a sample's weight is the largest over its target dates.
training: two runs on an H200. A run lost to the node is restarted from the beginning, unchanged.
test: exactly as evaluation/pavo_spectral_plan.json: 2025-08-01..2026-09-06, 4 members, BRIS_LEADTIMES=7, +30 h, strict common cases of all four models and MEPS, scripts/hits_and_calibration.py --cv month --replicates 5000 --meps, one --comparator per contrast.

primary_endpoint.measure: Brier score at 20 mm per day after month-out isotonic calibration, controlfft2000os minus controlfft2000: oversampling alone, as an alternative to the tail term
primary_endpoint.uncertainty: paired block bootstrap, seven-day blocks, 5000 replicates
primary_endpoint.positive_if: the upper 95 percent bound is below 0
primary_endpoint.negative_if: the lower 95 percent bound is above 0

key_secondary.measure: the same, tailCfft2000os minus tailCfft2000: oversampling on top of the tail term

registered_expectation: Oversampling alone gives a smaller gain than the tail term (controlfft2000os is behind tailCfft2000), and on top of the tail term it adds most at 50 mm. Reported whichever way it goes.
secondary_reported: controlfft2000os minus tailCfft2000, the two routes to the tail against each other
